transcript: New York's hottest night club is the 79th annual Tony Awards, located beneath Radio City Music Hall in a haunted vape shop. This club has everything. Pink as a vampire Peter Pan making out with a cast of the lost boys while flying over Patti LuPone’s confused face. The company of schmigadoon traps everyone in Radio City, forcing them to listen to Lin Manuel singing Renee Elise Goldsberry's rendition of satisfied Luke Evans Non-Nipples. Caissie Levy, Joshua Henry, and Nicholas Christopher hold notes so long. It resurrects the ghosts of Elaine Stritch, Angela Lansbury, and Dame Maggie Smith, who each visit Scott Rudin as ghosts of the Christmas past. You figure out which is which. Spoiler: he's still Scott Rudin. Celine Dion as Marla Mindelle walks the runway at the Jellicle Ball while Daniel Radcliffe claps a fan so aggressively at Bernadette Peters’ face she uncharacteristically drops the F bomb on live television. Two strangers carrying a cake across New York. A chess game between Nathan Lane and John Lithgow serenaded by Lea Michelle in honor of pride, sponsored by Target Dan Cortese
classificationReason: Stefon-style parody bit referencing 3+ shows (The Lost Boys, Schmigadoon, CATS: The Jellicle Ball, Two Strangers, Chess, etc.) with no single production as the focus. No genuine opinion on any individual show.
